subject: Normalise lab_ala_l02 / lab_ala_l03 to canonical ala- ids for the one account holding them
description: Follow-up named by Chris at the BUG-267 quality gate, explicitly out of scope for a house-list fix and NOT a blocker for it. Two real completions on ONE account use underscore ids (lab_ala_l02, lab_ala_l03) that match no {house}-{key} shape, so the client integrity check still counts them as 2 garbage entries against a lockout threshold of 5. That account was at 14/5 before BUG-267 and is at 2/5 now, so it is far safer than it was, but it is not at zero. WHY NOT JUST TOLERATE UNDERSCORES: module_XXXXXX is the exact garbage shape XPCalculator's own comment cites as the reason the guard exists, and it is an underscore id. Allowing underscores would reopen the hole the guard was built for, trading one student's 2 strikes for the return of a class of garbage that once put 942+ entries into user records. THE FIX IS DATA, NOT RULES: rename those two ids to canonical ala-l02 / ala-l03 in that account's modulesCompleted/labsCompleted. Requires (a) confirming ala-l02 / ala-l03 are the correct canonical ids for the real content, (b) a snapshot before and a diff after -- _tools/progress-snapshot/snapshot.js exists for exactly this, (c) writing to a real student record, which is a production write needing explicit operator authorization. Do NOT batch this with anything else; it touches one account and should be verifiable in a single diff.
